issues: 画面上只有渐变和一枚写着 LINEAR / RADIAL / CONIC 的调试小 pill，没有任何内容，像参数演示而不是镜头
radial 段外圈近黑、光斑偏小，整段读作黑屏；conic 段是七色彩虹，饱和到刺眼且和前两段不是一个色系
linear 段两色标明度接近，角度从 40° 扫到 230° 几乎看不出来，只是一块在缓慢变色的平底
180f 里没有节奏变化，三段等速推进，结尾没有落定的画面
changes: look 换成 aurora（紫粉暗场），三段都从同一组紫 / 品红 / 冰蓝取色，conic 改成 A→B→C→A 三色环、圆心放在主体右后方并压暗外圈
前景加一组发布会片头大字：「Bend light.」→「Focus it.」→ 260px 字标「Prism」+ 副标题，动词正好描述该段渐变的参数运动，换句与换类型同拍
linear 色标拉开三档明度（64 / 40 / 7），角度扫过时亮带走向清楚；radial 光斑半径 48%→80%、对角游走，不再黑屏
节奏重排为 200f：两次 12–14f 窄交叉淡化，文字虚化入场 / 上飘退场，conic 用慢起长尾旋转落定，尾段 40f hold
渐变改在 480×270 小画布作画再放大 4×，conic 的模糊在小画布上做，叠颗粒防色带；底部 mono 注记实时读出正在插值的参数与段号
issuesEn: The frame held nothing but a gradient and a small debug pill reading LINEAR / RADIAL / CONIC: a parameter demo rather than a shot
The radial pass had a near-black rim and a small glow, so it read as a black screen; the conic pass was a seven-colour rainbow, oversaturated and off-palette
The linear stops were close in value, so the 40° to 230° sweep was barely visible, just a flat field slowly changing hue
180f with no change of pace: three passes at the same speed and no settled ending
changesEn: Aurora look (violet-pink dark stage): all three passes draw from one violet, magenta and ice-blue set, and the conic is now an A-B-C-A three-colour ring centred behind the subject with a darkened rim

Launch-title typography in front: 'Bend light.' then 'Focus it.' then a 260px 'Prism' wordmark with subtitle; each verb describes what that gradient's parameters are doing, and the line changes on the same beat as the gradient type
Linear stops now span three values (64 / 40 / 7) so the bright band visibly sweeps; the radial glow grows from 48% to 80% while travelling diagonally instead of reading as black
Re-timed to 200f: two narrow 12–14f crossfades, lines blur in and float out, the conic spin starts slow and settles with a long tail, and there is a 40f end hold
Gradients are painted on a 480x270 canvas and scaled 4x, with the conic blur done at small size and grain on top against banding; a mono caption reads out the live parameters and the pass number
